basis.cd118: whole tracts from the Census CD-to-tract tabulation (geo/tract_cd118.json); every other tract straddles and carries land-area shares from overlaying the 500k tract with the 20m district polygons (approximate)
basis.cd116: overlay of the 500k tract with the 20m 116th-map polygons only (no Census tabulation of 2020 tracts against the 116th map exists); approximate
basis.lat_lon: a point inside the tract (representative point of the 500k polygon)
